mapper.select: SELECT workspace_id FROM workspace_members WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY member_id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refresh_tokens (user_id, token, expired_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{token}, #{expiredAt})
INSERT INTO users (email, password, nickname, provider, provider_id, email_verified) VALUES (#{email}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{provider}, #{providerId}, #{emailVerified})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET email_verified = TRUE, password = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_social_accounts (user_id, provider, provider_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{provider}, #{providerId})
INSERT INTO email_verification_tokens (user_id, token_hash, expires_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt})
INSERT INTO password_reset_tokens (user_id, token_hash, expires_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt})
